activities.description:
IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bronze.vehiculos
    WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(nro_bus)), '') IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(placa)), '') IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(tipo_bus)), '') IS NULL
       OR TRY_CONVERT(int, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(capacidad)), '')) IS NULL
       OR TRY_CONVERT(date, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(fecha_desde)), ''), 23) IS NULL
       OR TRY_CONVERT(date, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(fecha_hasta)), ''), 23) IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(estado)), '') IS NULL
)
    THROW 51002, 'Bronze.vehiculos tiene valores vacíos o inválidos; se cancela pipeline_silver.', 1;

scripts.text:
SELECT TOP (100)
    AnioFuente,
    VehiculoId,
    Placa,
    TipoVehiculo,
    CapacidadEfectiva,
    VigenciaDesde,
    VigenciaHasta,
    Estado,

    CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(AnioFuente)), '') IS NULL
         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS AnioFuenteVacio,
    CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(AnioFuente)), '') IS NOT NULL
              AND TRY_CONVERT(smallint, LTRIM(RTRIM(AnioFuente))) IS NULL
         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS AnioFuenteInvalido,

    CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(VehiculoId)), '') IS NULL
         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS VehiculoIdVacio,
    CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(Placa)), '') IS NULL
         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS PlacaVacia,
    CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(TipoVehiculo)), '') IS NULL
         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS TipoVehiculoVacio,

    CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CapacidadEfectiva)), '') IS NOT NULL
              AND TRY_CONVERT(int, LTRIM(RTRIM(CapacidadEfectiva))) IS NULL
         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS CapacidadInvalida,

    CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(VigenciaDesde)), '') IS NOT NULL
              AND TRY_CONVERT(date, LTRIM(RTRIM(VigenciaDesde)), 23) IS NULL
         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS VigenciaDesdeInvalida,
    CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(VigenciaHasta)), '') IS NOT NULL
              AND TRY_CONVERT(date, LTRIM(RTRIM(VigenciaHasta)), 23) IS NULL
         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS VigenciaHastaInvalida,

    CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(Estado)), '') IS NULL
         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS EstadoVacio
FROM bronze.vehiculos
WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(AnioFuente)), '') IS NULL
   OR TRY_CONVERT(smallint, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(AnioFuente)), '')) IS NULL
   OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(VehiculoId)), '') IS NULL
   OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(Placa)), '') IS NULL
   OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(TipoVehiculo)), '') IS NULL
   OR TRY_CONVERT(int, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CapacidadEfectiva)), '')) IS NULL
   OR TRY_CONVERT(date, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(VigenciaDesde)), ''), 23) IS NULL
   OR TRY_CONVERT(date, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(VigenciaHasta)), ''), 23) IS NULL
   OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(Estado)), '') IS NULL;
